//: Sleep (06 §8.4, 15 §4; D-930). The engine has no idea of sleep: a sleeper is whoever carries the tag `asleep`, which this trait gives. The bundled senses say what it does: `human_sight` is stopped by it, and `human_hearing` works on with a threshold twenty times its waking one, so only a sound that loud at the ear is heard, and whatever is heard wakes the sleeper (`rules/sleep.json`). A sneak whose steps stay under it passes unseen.
name: Asleep

//: Just woken: for a minute a sleeper lies awake, seeing and hearing as ever, before it drops off again (`rules/sleep.json`).
name: Woken
